name: MarqueeX – Smooth Marquee & Infinite Scroll for Gutenberg
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
MarqueeX – The Ultimate Marquee & Infinite Scroll Block for Gutenberg

Looking to add an infinite scrolling text effect or a smooth marquee animation to your WordPress site? MarqueeX is the perfect Gutenberg block plugin designed to create stunning marquee animations and scrolling elements with ease. Whether you need a news ticker, text slider, or an attention-grabbing announcement, MarqueeX provides all the customization you need for a seamless scrolling experience.

Key Features:

✔ Horizontal and vertical marquee directions.
✔ Customizable speed, delay, loop settings, and smooth animations.
✔ Full styling options – adjust font size, color, spacing, and more.
✔ Hover pause functionality for better user interaction.
✔ Infinite scrolling effect for seamless text transitions.
✔ Optimized for modern browsers and mobile responsiveness.
✔ Easy-to-use settings in the Gutenberg block editor – no coding required!

Why Use MarqueeX?

✅ SEO-Optimized – Enhance user engagement with dynamic, eye-catching content.
✅ Super Lightweight & Fast – Does not slow down your website.
✅ Fully Responsive – Works perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
✅ Perfect for Bloggers, Marketers, & Developers – Use it for news tickers, scrolling testimonials, promotions, or animated headings.
✅ No Dependencies – Built for Gutenberg, ensuring compatibility with all WordPress themes.

How to Use MarqueeX?

Install and activate MarqueeX from the WordPress plugin repository.

Add the “MarqueeX” block to any post or page using the Gutenberg editor.

Customize the scrolling direction, speed, colors, and styles.

Preview the animation and publish your page!
sections.installation:
Download and install MarqueeX from the WordPress plugins directory.

Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Add the MarqueeX block to any page or post and start customizing it to fit your design.
sections.faq:
Is MarqueeX free?

Yes! MarqueeX is a 100% free and open-source WordPress plugin.

Does it work with all WordPress themes?

Absolutely! MarqueeX is designed to work seamlessly with any WordPress theme that supports Gutenberg.

Can I control the scrolling speed and direction?

Yes! You can adjust the speed, direction (left, right, up, down), and loop settings directly from the Gutenberg block settings.

Does MarqueeX support infinite scrolling?

Yes! MarqueeX provides a continuous scrolling effect, perfect for news tickers, promotional banners, and animated sliders.
